questions.subject: INTEGRATED_2
questions.learningObjective: compute the slope of a line from two points
questions.stem: A ramp rises 3 metres over a horizontal distance of 9 metres. What is its slope?

options.misconception: uses the rise as the slope
uses the run as the slope

questions.explanation: Slope is rise over run, so 2 divided by 8 gives 1/4. Inverting rise and run gives 4, and using either the rise or the run alone forgets the division that defines slope.

questions.learningObjective: find the equation of a horizontal line
questions.stem: What is the y-intercept of the line y = 3x + 7?

options.text: Infinity, because the slope is unbounded
Undefined, because the line is vertical
1, because the line has unit slope
options.misconception: names "1, because the line has unit slope" where the rule requires "0, because a horizontal line has no rise"

options.text: 0, because a horizontal line has no rise

questions.explanation: The linear equations principle here is: Rise is zero. On that basis "0, because a horizontal line has no rise" is correct, while "Infinity, because the slope is unbounded" misremembers vertical slope.
